prompt: You have organised cakes and snacks for a small work celebration. As people start helping themselves, you notice a colleague with a serious nut allergy quietly skipping everything because nothing is labelled and they cannot tell what is safe. What is the most inclusive response?

options.text: Check the ingredients, add a clearly labelled nut-free option alongside the rest, and let your colleague know privately where it is
Remove all the treats containing nuts from the table so there is no risk and no need to mention it
Announce to the room that everyone must be careful because one person has an allergy
Say nothing this time and just remember to think about allergies at the next celebration

explanation: Adding a clearly labelled safe option means your colleague can join in like everyone else instead of sitting out quietly, and checking ingredients yourself avoids putting them on the spot in front of the whole office.
